text:
Maya: Quick check — about to merge PR #3456 that touches k8s overlays and Terraform. It migrates secrets from SSM -> SecretManager and updates the overlay variable `secretManagerPath`. Can someone confirm the staging overlay wiring looks correct and the prod release gate won't choke? I pasted the TF snippet from the plan below.

Ajay: Will take a look. If the plan only renames paths and keeps the IAM bindings intact it's probably fine. Watch the IAM change — the canary SA needs `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor`.

Leah: Reminder: our release-gate runs a kustomize diff that scans for any `namespace` and `patchesStrategicMerge` changes. The gate expects overlays/staging/patch.yaml to include the secret patch. Does the PR add that file?

Maya: Yes — PR includes `overlays/staging/secret-patch.yaml` and the overlay updates `patchesStrategicMerge: - secret-patch.yaml`. But CI `terraform plan` failed in sandbox with an API quota error. Copy of the small snippet from the plan: 

```hcl
# module.secretmanager.google_secret_version.new[0] will be created
+ resource "google_secret_version" "new" {
+   secret = "projects/project-redwood/secretManager/infra/staging/secrets/v2/my-secret"
+ }
# module.iam.google_service_account_iam_binding.canary: WILL BE UPDATED
~ resource "google_service_account_iam_binding" "canary" {
    role = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
 }
```

infra-bot: Alert: project-redwood-sandbox hit Secret Manager API quota (requests per minute) yesterday. Suggest either: request a quota bump for sandbox OR add provider-side retries/backoff in the TF provider config. See internal KB: https://docs.redwood.internal/infra/quotas#secretmanager

Nick: For the gate flow — current rule: `tf plan` must succeed, overlay-canary CI job must be green for 1 hour with no errors, then manual promote checkpoint. Maya, can you trigger the canary job? Post the job link so we can monitor.

Maya: Kicked the canary: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/98765 — plan output shows the secret path rename from `/env/staging/old` -> `/infra/staging/secrets/v2`. Any objections to the new canonical path? :thinking_face:

Ajay: No objections to the path, but two follow-ups: (1) update secrets rotation docs to reference the new path, (2) ensure KMS key binding is correct for prod (we've seen mismatches cause access failures). Also add a TF var `legacy_ssm_path` as a compatibility shim in case we need an immediate rollback.

Leah: I'll open a quick PR review pass. If the canary fails I can help with rollback steps. Ping me with the CI failure link.

Maya: Thanks all — plan is to promote if canary stays green by 11:20am PT. If anything flakes we revert commit + add shim var, then re-run. I'll update the PR description with a short checklist: 1) confirm IAM binding, 2) docs updated, 3) canary green for 1 hour, 4) manual promote.

Nick: Sounds good. Also add an item to the release gate sheet noting the quota risk so SRE can pre-request a bump for prod.

Maya: Will do. cc @infra-bot for follow-up on quota request. :thumbsup:
